attributes.note: Attributes hold claim-level metadata only (how this annotation was made). WHEN it was made is 'assessed_at', which is a column: an annotation re-evaluated at another date is a second assessment of the same claim, not a second annotation. Object properties such as roof slope, use, or construction era live in the CityGML/ADE source, reachable through city_object_uid - never duplicated into USAP.

Same annotation_uid, later date: this entry adds a second assessment rather than overwriting the first. Its membership is the re-surveyed extent; the 2026 assessment keeps its own. Requires replace_existing=True, since the annotation already exists.
